items.title: Making Democracy Work: Fixing and Simplifying Egalitarian Paxos
items.title_zh: 让民主运转：修复并简化 Egalitarian Paxos
items.summary: The paper revisits Egalitarian Paxos, a leaderless state-machine replication protocol that lets replicas order commands collaboratively and can execute a command in two message delays under stated failure and commutativity conditions. It aims to fix and simplify the protocol, which avoids the single point of failure and latency penalties of leader-based Paxos.
